title: Ocean Letter Splash
hook: Splash-splash! Ride the ripple with me,
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one beat of quiet after the letter cue
visualStyle: friendly polished 3D storybook ocean art, aqua and coral palette, soft rounded shapes, clean preschool character design

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: child-sized observer riding one ripple through changing ocean layers
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: ultra-repeatable movement hook with a clean me/Z rhyme and no explanatory prose
creativeFingerprint.grooveMeter: rolling 4/4 acoustic-pop with a light triplet undertow
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: song-first ocean snapshots: target early, one concrete image or fact, strong internal sound where natural, and deliberate short lines between richer teaching moments
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: brief clue -> one real beat -> target -> tiny semantic gesture; child response stays much shorter than Round 1 and rotates shape, motion, habitat, and function clues
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: A-H close and buoyant; I-P slightly wider; Q-X more spacious for rare words and wow-facts; Y-Z drift outward; interlude nearly empties; Round 2 is voice-first stop-start recall; final chorus blooms once before a tide-like strip-down
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: two-note marimba ripple answers after targets, never on their first syllable
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make the catalog opener feel like one musical ripple, not a nature encyclopedia: it starts tiny, crosses reef and shore, dips through deeper water, rises for breath and light, then carries the final letter back toward the first ripple. Facts should be memorable because the phrasing moves, surprises, and sings.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: Ripple-motion is the signature. Short sound-words and child-repeatable verbs - plip, bob, flick, swish, glide, dip, rise, drift - alternate with a few vivid wow-facts. Information weight deliberately breathes: some letters are quick musical hits, others open into a larger image.
semanticArc: one ripple opens and finds reef life
shore structures and seafloor movement widen the scene
deep water rises repeatedly toward light and air
current carries Y and Z back toward the opening ripple
